items.title: Bob Magnusson interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: I got the Buddy Rich band job... I stayed a year playing with the band... he taught me a lot.

ctx.x: Yeah, it was a wild story. And then later — I did that for a season and then I moved to Las Vegas. I had met some guys. Played a couple of show bands. And through there I got the Buddy Rich band job.
Were you playing electric at the same time?
